name: Cueport
subtitle: A local-first music player for DJs
description: Cueport reads your Serato library or builds its own from the music folders on your computer. Pair your phone to the computer over your local network, send selected collections across, and play them anywhere. Create new collections and make edits on either device. Your computer is the source of truth and the phone pairs to it.

shipNotes.title: Cueport 1.1: local-first library management for desktop and phone
included: Read Serato crates, subcrates, tracks, cues, BPM, key, color, comments, and beatgrid markers from your local library
Use Cueport Direct to scan one or more music folders into its own database without requiring Serato
Analyze Cueport Direct tracks with trail mix for integer display BPM, key, waveform height, and band-energy color hints
Play tracks locally from the desktop library with waveform context, cue markers, and continuous playback
Create, rename, delete, add tracks to, and manually reorder collections before publishing them back
Edit cue points, track comments, and track colors in a local working layer before any write-back happens
Review pending changes before publishing to Serato, with restore points for every publish
Pair an iPhone over the local network, choose collections for the phone, cache audio, and prefetch waveform data and beatgrids in the background
Show the paired source on iPhone and keep queued edits tied to that source
Use desktop and mobile column sorting as temporary views while keeping the # column as the manual order
Recover from pairing changes without deleting cached phone music
Album art from embedded ID3 tags shown in desktop track lists, mobile track detail, and lock screen
Tracks start playback at the first cue point on both desktop and mobile, matching Serato behavior
Skip previous and next buttons in the desktop player transport
In-app Wi-Fi isolation diagnostic and guided hotspot prompt for public networks
Faster mobile pairing by deferring artwork downloads until after audio sync
Full-waveform iPhone overlay with colored bars, bar markers, live time, square cues, cue add, and cue move
Signed Mac app build with local-first behavior and no music upload requirement
